description: post_reel.py ALREADY implements a reconciliation mechanism for exactly REQ-008's stated purpose ('so the loop never double-posts'): the `--verify-only` flag (post_reel.py:82, 111-118, comments tagged FIND-502/FIND-601) navigates to the profile and returns current reel hrefs with a fail-closed `ok` flag specifically to let a caller detect whether a previous timeout-killed attempt actually landed. The 'Out of scope' section (behavioral-spec.md:35-42) lists three unrelated out-of-scope items but never mentions this pre-existing, directly-overlapping mechanism, and REQ-008 (behavioral-spec.md:70-74) describes a self-heal re-check without saying whether it reuses `--verify-only`, replaces it, or coexists with it as a separate code path. This ambiguity risks the implementer building a second, parallel reconciliation mechanism alongside the existing one, doubling the surface area for exactly the kind of race-condition bug this feature is meant to eliminate.
